notes: Portal: owners.hyundaiusa.com > Hyundai Resources > Manuals & Warranties (https://owners.hyundaiusa.com/us/en/resources/manuals-warranties). The page HTML has no document links; its JS loads the list via POST /bin/common/resourceResult (params resultType=manualandwarranties, year, model) and /content/myhyundai/us/en/service/manualsandwarrantiesdata.json. owners.hyundaiusa.com/robots.txt disallows /bin/, /content/ and /api/ for all user-agents, so these endpoints were NOT called and no PDF under owners.hyundaiusa.com/content/dam/... was requested (not even a 1 KB range check). Model-specific owner's manuals / QRGs / guides were therefore collected only from a site-restricted web search index (WebSearch allowed_domains=owners.hyundaiusa.com) and are listed with how='site_search' and verified='not_fetched ...'. Observed URL pattern (not used for guessing): owners.hyundaiusa.com/content/dam/hyundai/us/myhyundai/manuals/{glovebox-manual|factory-warranty|erg|erqrg}/{year}/{model-folder}/{file}.pdf; file names are inconsistent across years, so no pattern expansion was attempted. No login/VIN is needed to open these PDFs per the search index, but listing them requires the dynamic (robots-disallowed) endpoint. Verified documents: all-models Owner's Handbook & Warranty Information PDFs on www.hyundaiusa.com/content/dam/hyundai/us/com/pdf/assurance/ (robots.txt allows); 2020-2026 are linked from https://www.hyundaiusa.com/us/en/assurance/america-best-warranty, 2019 found via search; all range-checked (206, application/pdf, %PDF). These all-models handbooks are expanded per line/year in 'documents' and listed once in 'shared_documents' (with alternate versions). Pattern check 'Hyundai USA ALL {14..18}MY(Main).pdf' on www returned 404 (not listed). Year mapping: 'year' is the model-year folder in the URL; one exception noted in the title (2024 Tucson PHEV OM stored under the 2023 folder, listed as 2024). Elantra line includes Elantra GT (2018 'Elantra PD' OM is the GT hatchback), Elantra N/N Line, Elantra Hybrid; Sonata includes Hybrid/PHEV; Santa Fe includes Hybrid/PHEV. Out of scope / not used: ownersmanual.hyundai.com (Hyundai Motor Company web manuals, e.g. full_webhelp/.../en_US) is not a hyundaiusa.com host and was not seen linked from the hyundaiusa.com pages fetched; digitalownersmanual.hyundai.com (linked for IONIQ 5/6 only) did not resolve from this network. No Canada/other-market Hyundai documents were collected.
